integrity: The claimed all-parameter proof is symbolic; standalone finite tests reconstruct filtration faces, verify explicit elementary collapses, and compare the quotient graph; no independent validation is implied.
scientific_limitations: Only full strong discrete-Morse matching complexes of unfilled K_{m,n}, with m,n >= 2, are classified; excludes pure strong and ordinary Morse complexes. Full text of motivating preprint not accessible, hence residual originality risk. No independent audit.
title: A circle-wedge classification for full strong Morse complexes of complete bipartite graphs
